Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing.

# Pharmaceutical Wholesaler UK | MHRA-Licensed Exporter to Africa and the Middle East

Global Pharma Distributor (GPD) is a pharmaceutical wholesaler UK and international buyers turn to
for compliant, export-ready medicines. We hold a Wholesale Dealer Authorisation (Human) from the
MHRA and run to Good Distribution Practice (GDP) standards, from the point a product is sourced to
the day it leaves our facility near London Heathrow.
We buy from approved UK and European suppliers, hold stock in temperature-controlled storage, and
build each consignment with the paperwork institutional buyers and regulators actually ask for:

certificates of analysis, batch traceability, temperature logs, and full export documentation. Under
our licence we procure, hold, and export medicines to other businesses, never directly to the
public, and a designated Responsible Person oversees GDP compliance. We’re a licensed distributor
and exporter, not a manufacturer.

[Request GDP-Compliant Export Documentation][17]

## Pharmaceutical Wholesaler UK With Global Export Reach

GPD has spent years coordinating supply for authorised importers, hospital groups, and government
health programmes in more than one region. Most of what we do is invisible to the patient at the end
of the chain, and that’s by design. Buyers stay with us because shipments arrive documented,
traceable, and ready for inspection, not because of a sales pitch.
Every product follows the same route: verified sourcing, GDP storage, and consignment preparation
under Responsible Person oversight, exactly as a WDA(H) requires. The MHRA inspects licensed sites
against GDP before a licence is granted and at intervals afterwards, so the standard is never
optional.

## Our Products
## Change Lives

We strive to provide Regenerative Products of exceptional quality, all while keeping them
affordable. Our ultimate aim is to offer the most effective solutions possible, without compromising
on quality. Our commitment to excellence means that you can provide the best possible care to your
patients, without having to make any compromises.

Post-doctoral scientists, physicians & surgeons with expertise in science & medicine

New developments & invention in scientific, diagnostic & therapeutics

Executive management with absolute focus on bringing safe & effective products to market

At our core, we are a team of passionate individuals dedicated to advancing the field of
regenerative medicine. Our mission is to harness the power of nature to help patients heal faster
and more effectively than ever before. Through cutting-edge techniques and rigorous scientific
study, we create human perinatal-derived products that support the body’s natural healing processes.
Our goal is to provide the most innovative and effective solutions possible, improving patients’
lives and helping them achieve optimal health and wellness.

[Abstract, swirling metallic form representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics.][Abstract,
swirling metallic form representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics.]

## Our Process & Procurement

[Pregnant woman icon representing perinatal tissue source for regenerative biologics.][Pregnant
woman icon representing perinatal tissue source for regenerative biologics.]

### Prescreening

Platinum Biologics products are obtained from healthy, carefully screened mothers at the time of
normal delivery. In addition to a stringent social screening interview, all mothers undergo serology
testing to ensure there is no risk for a communicable disease. No harm is brought to the mother or
her newborn and parents still have the option of storing the cord blood if desired.

[DNA helix icon representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.][DNA helix icon
representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.]

### Processing

Recovery of tissue is performed at the time of delivery by trained technicians in a sterile
environment. All processing is done in a cGMP facility following the regulations of the FDA and the
guidelines of the American Association of Tissue Banks (AATB) and the American Association of Blood
Banks (AABB).

[Validated shipping containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.][Validated shipping
containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.]

### Distribution

All Platinum Biologics products are shipped on dry ice in validated shipping containers to ensure
appropriate temperature is maintained.

[ Learn More ][16]

Platinum Biologics products are manufactured in state-of-the-art ISO Class cleanrooms. All equipment
is calibrated and validated to ensure consistent results are produced. Our facility is
FDA-registered and a multi-state licensed tissue bank providing high-quality natural biologics to
clinicians nationwide. We work closely with our partners to enhance their practice with the tools
and training necessary to implement natural biologics into their standard of care.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics is a wellness-focused company that offers nutritional supplements, biologic
formulations, and innovative health products designed to support a variety of wellness goals.
What types of products does Platinum Biologics offer?
Platinum Biologics provides dietary supplements, biologic products, wellness formulations, and
specialty health solutions featuring a range of nutritional and functional ingredients.
What are biologics?
Biologics are products derived from biological sources or developed using biological processes and
are commonly researched and utilized in health, wellness, and scientific fields.
What is the focus of Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics focuses on developing innovative wellness products that combine science-based
ingredients with modern formulation technologies.
What ingredients are commonly found in Platinum Biologics products?
Depending on the product, ingredients may include collagen, amino acids, antioxidants, botanical
extracts, peptides, vitamins, minerals, and other wellness-supporting compounds.
What is collagen and why is it important?
Collagen is a structural protein naturally present in the body that supports connective tissues,
skin, joints, and overall structural integrity.
What are antioxidants?
Antioxidants are compounds that help protect cells from oxidative stress caused by free radicals and
support normal cellular function.
What role do amino acids play in wellness products?
Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins and are involved in numerous biological processes
related to metabolism, tissue maintenance, and cellular function.
Are Platinum Biologics products manufactured under quality standards?
Reputable supplement manufacturers typically follow quality control practices and manufacturing
standards to help ensure product consistency and reliability.
Who can benefit from wellness supplements?
Wellness supplements are often used by individuals seeking nutritional support, active lifestyle
products, and complementary additions to their overall health routines.
Does Platinum Biologics offer innovative delivery technologies?
Platinum Biologics products may utilize advanced formulation approaches designed to improve
convenience, ingredient stability, and product effectiveness.
Why is ingredient transparency important when choosing supplements?
Ingredient transparency helps consumers understand what is included in a product and allows them to
make informed purchasing decisions based on their wellness goals.
How can customers choose the right Platinum Biologics product?
Customers can compare ingredients, formulation types, product descriptions, wellness objectives, and
usage recommendations when selecting a product.
Where can consumers purchase Platinum Biologics products?
Consumers can browse and purchase available products directly through the Platinum Biologics website
and authorized distribution channels.
Why choose Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics offers wellness-focused formulations, science-driven product development, quality
ingredients, and a diverse portfolio of products designed to support modern health and wellness
lifestyles.

What is Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics is a wellness-focused company that offers nutritional supplements, biologic

What types of products does Platinum Biologics offer?
Platinum Biologics provides dietary supplements, biologic products, wellness formulations, and
specialty health solutions featuring a range of nutritional and functional ingredients.
What are biologics?
Biologics are products derived from biological sources or developed using biological processes and
are commonly researched and utilized in health, wellness, and scientific fields.
What is the focus of Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics focuses on developing innovative wellness products that combine science-based
ingredients with modern formulation technologies.
What ingredients are commonly found in Platinum Biologics products?
Depending on the product, ingredients may include collagen, amino acids, antioxidants, botanical
extracts, peptides, vitamins, minerals, and other wellness-supporting compounds.
What is collagen and why is it important?
Collagen is a structural protein naturally present in the body that supports connective tissues,
skin, joints, and overall structural integrity.
What are antioxidants?
Antioxidants are compounds that help protect cells from oxidative stress caused by free radicals and
support normal cellular function.
What role do amino acids play in wellness products?
Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins and are involved in numerous biological processes
related to metabolism, tissue maintenance, and cellular function.
Are Platinum Biologics products manufactured under quality standards?
Reputable supplement manufacturers typically follow quality control practices and manufacturing
standards to help ensure product consistency and reliability.
Who can benefit from wellness supplements?
Wellness supplements are often used by individuals seeking nutritional support, active lifestyle
products, and complementary additions to their overall health routines.
Does Platinum Biologics offer innovative delivery technologies?
Platinum Biologics products may utilize advanced formulation approaches designed to improve
convenience, ingredient stability, and product effectiveness.
Why is ingredient transparency important when choosing supplements?
Ingredient transparency helps consumers understand what is included in a product and allows them to
make informed purchasing decisions based on their wellness goals.
How can customers choose the right Platinum Biologics product?
Customers can compare ingredients, formulation types, product descriptions, wellness objectives, and
usage recommendations when selecting a product.
Where can consumers purchase Platinum Biologics products?
Consumers can browse and purchase available products directly through the Platinum Biologics website
and authorized distribution channels.
Why choose Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics offers wellness-focused formulations, science-driven product development, quality
ingredients, and a diverse portfolio of products designed to support modern health and wellness
lifestyles.

## Profil is the world's leading full-service CRO for diabetes and obesity research.

As a full-service CRO for early clinical trials in diabetes and obesity, Profil has brought together
regulatory and scientific experts so that we can offer you unrivalled service. We focus that
expertise on developing sophisticated experimental methods, optimizing study designs, and delivering
critical answers for further compound development.

Profil began life as a spin-off of an academic study group at the Department of Metabolic Diseases
and Nutrition at the University of Düsseldorf. Our founders wished to create a dedicated CRO that
would address the challenges of diabetes and obesity research and treatment. The company’s
achievements are testament to that vision.

Over the years, we have implemented numerous sophisticated methods for [pharmacodynamic
characterization][82] of the effects of compounds in early phase trials, and we have been involved
in the development of all the currently available major anti-diabetic compounds. Our key competence
is the performance of glucose clamp studies, often combined with isotope dilution techniques and
muscle or fat biopsies.

## Profil is the world's leading full-service CRO for diabetes and obesity research.

As a full-service CRO for early clinical trials in diabetes and obesity, Profil has brought together
regulatory and scientific experts so that we can offer you unrivalled service. We focus that
expertise on developing sophisticated experimental methods, optimizing study designs, and delivering
critical answers for further compound development.

Profil began life as a spin-off of an academic study group at the Department of Metabolic Diseases
and Nutrition at the University of Düsseldorf. Our founders wished to create a dedicated CRO that
would address the challenges of diabetes and obesity research and treatment. The company’s
achievements are testament to that vision.

Over the years, we have implemented numerous sophisticated methods for [pharmacodynamic
characterization][82] of the effects of compounds in early phase trials, and we have been involved
in the development of all the currently available major anti-diabetic compounds. Our key competence
is the performance of glucose clamp studies, often combined with isotope dilution techniques and
muscle or fat biopsies.

The Most Cost Effective PRP Kits Available with the Highest Platelet Concentration

conditions. Not only can it help patients avoid the need for potentially risky surgery, it

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

SingleCare is a prescription discount service that offers free coupons on thousands of prescription
drugs. It can be used whether you have insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, or none of the above, but it
cannot be combined with insurance.

SingleCare provides transparent drug pricing, so you can compare discounts at pharmacies near you.
Browse singlecare.com to find drug discounts, helpful information about your prescription, and
resources to help you make informed health decisions.

**Prescription savings vary by prescription and by pharmacy, and may reach up to 80% off cash
price.** This is a medical discount plan. This is NOT insurance. This program offers you the
opportunity to locate providers of various types of medical services who will offer their services
to you at discounted rates. The range of discounts for medical or ancillary services provided under
the plan will vary depending on the type of provider and service received. You are fully responsible
for paying for all health care services but will be entitled to receive a discount from those health
care providers in accordance with the specific pre-negotiated discounted fee schedule. This program
does not guarantee the quality of the services or procedures offered by the providers. Except for
prescription drugs which you will pay directly to the pharmacy at the time of purchase, all other
services received through a program provider will be charged to the credit card on file in your
member account. The charge will include an administrative fee for use of the program. Towers
Administrators LLC is the licensed discount medical plan organization with its administrative office
located at 4510 Cox Road, Suite 111, Glen Allen, VA 23060. SingleCare Services, LLC is the marketer
of the discount medical plan organization including its website, singlecare.com, with its corporate
office located at 99 High Street, Suite 2800, Boston, MA 02110. For additional information,
including an up-to-date list of providers, or assistance with any issue related to program
membership, please contact member support any time at www.singlecare.com, or by calling toll-free
844-234-3057, 24 hours, 7 days a week (except major holidays). Pharmacy names, logos, brands, and
other trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

Blog articles are not medical advice. They are intended for general informational purposes and are

Medical-grade skincare contains high-strength active ingredients backed by clinical research.

skincare and are typically recommended by professionals for optimal results.

Medical-grade skincare offers higher-strength ingredients and deeper results, making it more
effective for treating specific concerns than most over-the-counter products.

Medical-grade skincare contains high-strength active ingredients backed by clinical research.

Medical-grade skincare offers higher-strength ingredients and deeper results, making it more
effective for treating specific concerns than most over-the-counter products.

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.
